contract_scope_note: Reparo de persistência de resultados no escopo G3 autorizado, sem alterar o contrato matemático G2; não exige contrato de argumento de manuscrito.

findings.quoted_finding: Raw JAGS draws were not saved, preventing independent recomputation of reported MCSE and joint-draw functionals from this run.
defect_evidence: Implementation explicitly states raw draws were not saved in any attempt.
Harness calls coda.samples and writes summary CSV and JSON but does not persist the sample object.
mechanical_checks: Read implementation and inspected sampling/output calls in g3_jags.R.
Recomputed SHA-256 of the revision1 candidate manifest.
findings.reasoning: Seeds and summary tables alone do not provide the actual sampled rows needed for a source-bound independent recalculation. A new identical-protocol replay can supply verifiable new draws but cannot recover the unsaved original ones.
findings.disposition: Persist chains and metadata in a new output directory, replay the same small protocol unchanged, reopen the saved chains and calculate all summaries from them; retain prior candidate and attempts.

reasons: The bounded artifact repair is independent of F1/F2 and does not change the scientific target or test thresholds.
G3 execution and safe code repairs are already authorized; the revised candidate still requires independent review.

scope: Raw-draw persistence only; no G3 PASS or inferential approval.
